maria: Heads up — sketching a slot-gating + pacing prototype to reduce long/short tenant starvation. TL;DR: small per-tenant reserve + micro-slot admit + kernel hinting to avoid long tails.

jon: Interested. Quick q: how's this different from the soft-reserve credits we've tried?

maria: Soft-reserve ended up getting evicted under bursty short traffic and then long requests starved waiting for KV warmups. The idea here is different: 1) global micro-slots (e.g. 8) are fractionally assigned by recent seq-length mix, 2) each tenant gets a tiny min_token_reserve so long sequences get a predictable path, 3) admitting long sequences consumes a reserved slot and triggers a KV-prefetch hint and slow-path kernel allocation, while short sequences prefer fast-path kernel and can use ephemeral slots.

siva: Can you paste the pseudo-config so I can eyeball thresholds?

maria: ```
{
  "slot_config": {
    "global_slots": 8,
    "min_token_reserve_per_tenant": 64,
    "long_seq_threshold_tokens": 512,
    "idle_reclaim_ms": 50,
    "smoothing_window_s": 10
  },
  "admit_policy": "fractional-assignment",
  "kernel_hinting": {
    "fast_path_preference_ratio": 0.7,
    "force_slow_for_long": true
  }
}
```

ana: (typo) ana: perfbot, can you run a short profile of the canary config vs baseline on mixed workload?

perfbot: profile run scheduled. summary (2h mixed canary vs baseline): P50 +3ms, P95 -14ms, throughput +8% for mixed short/long mix, but observed P99 regression for tenant T42 (+120ms) under bursty arrivals. full trace uploaded to /perf/runs/1765/slot-gating-canary-1.log

jon: T42 is long-seq heavy — likely KV warmup + kernel swap cost. If reserved admits still require cold-KV loads we get the tail. Could prefetch KV and pin a tiny prefetch worker for reserved slots.

maria: Agreed. Plan: step 1) implement admit rules + slot accounting and reclaim policy; step 2) add KV prefetch/hint path on reserved admits; step 3) add telemetry (slot_utilization per tenant, queue_age_by_seq_len, kernel_switch_count); step 4) run canary and collect tail metrics and traces.

siva: Need a safety reclaim to avoid underutilization: allow reclaiming reserved slots if idle > idle_reclaim_ms, but with smoothing to avoid flip-flop.

maria: Exactly — reclaim after 50ms idle + smoothing_window_s=10 to dampen oscillation. Also will add a fast fallback: if reserved slots unused for >200ms during high QPS, let short seqs burst into them with degraded kernel hints.

ana: ana: please add a minimal repro script for T42 pattern so we can iterate offline.

jon: Also surface kernel-choice per-batch in tracing: kernel=fast|slow and kv_hit_rate so we can correlate tail spikes.

maria: Good call. I'll open a PR with the admit simulator, config, and a small canary job. Will tag you all. cc @perfbot to run nightly sims and diff results. :thumbsup:

perfbot: ack — nightly sim added and will post diffs to #eng-runtime/perf-canaries.
